title: SCALE: Constructing Structured Natural Language Comment Trees for Software Vulnerability Detection
note: Full-text (ar5iv). SCT = AST + LLM comments flattened to structured NL text, fused via cross-attention during pre-trained model fine-tuning; RQ4 ablates SCTC/SER components on same base model, isolating the representation's contribution.

title: ContractTinker: LLM-Empowered Vulnerability Repair for Real-World Smart Contracts
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Builds dependency graph from call graph+AST+DFG, prunes via slicing into a Contextual Dependency Graph, serialized as text across a multi-step (Q1-Q6) prompting/validation pipeline; 48 real-world contracts, no baseline comparison or ablation, only self-reported patch success rates.

title: Evaluating Large Language Models in Vulnerability Detection Under Variable Context Windows
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Raw unprocessed Java code (comments stripped) fed directly in prompts to 10 LLMs; token-length vs accuracy correlation measured via chi-square across models, not a representation-type ablation (representation is always raw text).

title: VulBinLLM: LLM-powered Vulnerability Detection for Stripped Binaries
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Decompiled pseudocode enriched with LLM-added vulnerability comments/renamed variables, plus a memory-management prompting scheme (no external tool calls); quantified vs LATTE baseline on Juliet dataset per-CWE, no ablation isolating components.

title: VerilogLAVD: LLM-Aided Rule Generation for Vulnerability Detection in Verilog
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Verilog Property Graph (VeriPG) fuses AST+CFG+DFG; LLM generates graph-traversal detection rules with a validation tool giving real-time feedback (loop), then a deterministic executor traverses VeriPG; quantified vs LLM-only and LLM+external-knowledge baselines, no raw-text-vs-graph ablation.

title: Learning to Triage Vulnerability Reports from Program Analysis: An Empirical Study in Node.js
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Best model (fine-tuned LLM) receives only a tool-guided truncated code snippet (raw text, selection guided by NodeMedic-FINE taint analysis) around the sink; compared across classical ML/GNN/LLM/hybrid architectures and a provenance-graph baseline, not a controlled representation-only ablation.

title: A Systematic Study of Code Obfuscation Against LLM-based Vulnerability Detection
note: Full-text (PDF, html unavailable/404). Raw source code (obfuscated vs original) given directly in prompts to 15 LLMs + 2 coding agents; core design holds model/prompt template fixed while varying only the obfuscation applied to the code text.

title: Beyond Function-Level Analysis: Context-Aware Reasoning for Inter-Procedural Vulnerability Detection
note: Full-text (ar5iv, CPRVul). Code property graph used internally to extract caller/callee/global-variable inter-procedural context (not serialized itself), profiled/ranked context fed as text and used to generate reasoning traces for LoRA fine-tuning; Table 8 ablates function-only vs +context vs +context+reasoning on same base LLM (Qwen2.5-32B).

title: How Code Representation Shapes False-Positive Dynamics in Cross-Language LLM Vulnerability Detection
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Explicit controlled comparison of raw source text vs pruned-AST-as-text input, LoRA fine-tuned on the same two 8B LLMs; cross-representation probe (text-trained weights on AST input, no retrain) isolates representation effect on FPR/recall across C/C++/Java/Python.

title: Revisiting Vul-RAG: Reproducibility and Replicability of RAG-based Vulnerability Detection with Open-Weight Models
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Retrieved CVE-derived knowledge entries (functional semantics, vulnerability cause, fixing solution) injected into prompts alongside code; reproduces Vul-RAG across many open-weight models, quantified against original results/random baseline, but no RAG-vs-no-RAG ablation on identical models.

title: Ethereum NFT Smart Contracts: Knowledge-Guided Vulnerability Detection with LLM and Code Slicing
note: Full-text (ar5iv). Regex+structure-aware slicing extracts line-numbered vulnerability-focused code slices, concatenated with a static ERC-721 domain-knowledge template into one DeepSeek prompt (no retrieval, no loop); ablation compares full system vs no-knowledge vs no-slicing/full-contract on same model, but metric is self-reported positive-label rate with no ground-truth labels.
